Every number resolves to a CI log, a Lean proof, or a Zenodo DOI. Append-only log of DSSE-signed governance decision receipts for the Unified Deployment Substrate (UDS) mesh. Each record captures: decision type, formula gates checked, gate results, actor ORCID, and a PAE v1 DSSE signature. Receipts are the authoritative audit trail for UDS deployment actions.
